title: Rear yard equivalent
previewText: Where the designated Residence District is an R6 through R12 District without a letter suffix, for buildings, or portions thereof, containing residential uses, the alternative location allowances set forth in paragraph (c)(2) of Section 23-343 (Rear yard equivalent requirements) shall not apply.
